title: Grow-Space Systems and Crop Planning Specialist Practical
criticalErrors: Designs material or personnel flow that knowingly creates an uncontrolled clean-to-dirty or quarantine-to-production contamination pathway.
Builds a crop schedule that exceeds a supplied hard capacity or environmental constraint without identifying the conflict.
Allows genetic-source or lot identity to become irretrievable during planned transfers.
Alters supplied capacity, inventory, or schedule evidence to make the plan appear feasible.
